Game Overview

Mr Pong is a arcade game built around bounce through a thrilling adventure with Mr. Pong, the mustachioed hero! Tap to control his jumps, deftly avoiding thorns and skillfully maneuvering across platforms. This addictive game challenges your agility and precision, ensuring endless fun as you strive for high scores in a lively arcade atmosphere.
